import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gs
AA3=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',LEU='L',LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V',MSE='M')
def parse(t,chain=None):
    res={};order=[]
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        if not l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ch=l[21]
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        ri=int(l[22:26]);an=l[12:16].strip()
        k=(ch,ri)
        if k not in res: res[k]=dict(one=AA3[rn],atoms={},b=[]);order.append(k)
        res[k]["atoms"][an]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]);res[k]["b"].append(float(l[60:66]))
    for k in res: res[k]["bmean"]=float(np.mean(res[k]["b"]))
    return res,order
F={a:requests.get(requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}",timeout=60).json()[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text for a in ["Q9N366","Q9BUJ0","Q96IU4"]}
F["1IMJ"]=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1IMJ.pdb",timeout=120).text
S={"C. elegans ABHD-14\n(AlphaFold Q9N366)":(parse(F["Q9N366"]),(145,193,220)),
   "Human ABHD14A\n(AlphaFold Q9BUJ0)":(parse(F["Q9BUJ0"]),(171,222,249)),
   "Human ABHD14B\n(AlphaFold Q96IU4)":(parse(F["Q96IU4"]),(111,162,188)),
   "Human ABHD14B\n(crystal 1IMJ, 1.5 A)":(parse(F["1IMJ"],"A"),(111,162,188))}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9.5))
G=gs.GridSpec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.05,1.0,1.0],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.25)

# ---- panel A: triad H-bond distances ----
axA=fig.add_subplot(G[0,0])
names=[];d1=[];d2=[];lab=[]
for n,((res,order),(s,dd,h)) in S.items():
    ch=order[0][0]
    og=res[(ch,s)]["atoms"]["OG"];ne2=res[(ch,h)]["atoms"]["NE2"];nd1=res[(ch,h)]["atoms"]["ND1"]
    acid=[v for k,v in res[(ch,dd)]["atoms"].items() if k in("OD1","OD2")]
    names.append(n); d1.append(np.linalg.norm(og-ne2)); d2.append(min(np.linalg.norm(nd1-a) for a in acid))
    lab.append(f"S{s}-D{dd}-H{h}")
x=np.arange(len(names)); w=0.36
axA.bar(x-w/2,d1,w,label="Ser OG $\\cdots$ His NE2",color="#2f6fb5")
axA.bar(x+w/2,d2,w,label="His ND1 $\\cdots$ Asp OD",color="#e08214")
axA.axhspan(2.5,3.3,color="green",alpha=0.12)
axA.text(3.45,3.35,"H-bond range\n2.5-3.3 A",fontsize=7,color="green",ha="right")
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(d1,d2)):
    axA.text(i-w/2,a+0.05,f"{a:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8); axA.text(i+w/2,b+0.05,f"{b:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axA.set_xticks(x); axA.set_xticklabels([f"{n}\n{l}" for n,l in zip(names,lab)],fontsize=7)
axA.set_ylabel("distance (A)"); axA.set_ylim(0,3.8); axA.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc="lower right")
axA.set_title("A. Catalytic triad is geometrically assembled in C. elegans ABHD-14",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# ---- panel B: oxyanion hole + elbow dihedrals ----
axB=fig.add_subplot(G[0,1])
HGp1={"C. elegans ABHD-14\n(AlphaFold Q9N366)":79,"Human ABHD14A\n(AlphaFold Q9BUJ0)":103,
      "Human ABHD14B\n(AlphaFold Q96IU4)":41,"Human ABHD14B\n(crystal 1IMJ, 1.5 A)":41}
o1=[];o2=[]
for n,((res,order),(s,dd,h)) in S.items():
    ch=order[0][0]; og=res[(ch,s)]["atoms"]["OG"]
    o1.append(np.linalg.norm(res[(ch,s+1)]["atoms"]["N"]-og))
    o2.append(np.linalg.norm(res[(ch,HGp1[n])]["atoms"]["N"]-og))
axB.bar(x-w/2,o1,w,label="backbone N of Ser+1",color="#4f9153")
axB.bar(x+w/2,o2,w,label="backbone N of HG+1",color="#9e6ebd")
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(o1,o2)):
    axB.text(i-w/2,a+0.07,f"{a:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8); axB.text(i+w/2,b+0.07,f"{b:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axB.set_xticks(x); axB.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=7); axB.set_ylabel("distance to Ser OG (A)")
axB.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); axB.set_ylim(0,6.6)
axB.set_title("B. Oxyanion-hole donors are in place and equivalent across all four models",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# ---- panel C: catalytic-region sequence blocks ----
axC=fig.add_subplot(G[1,:]); axC.axis("off")
blocks=[("HG / oxyanion motif",[("C. elegans","V74 I F L H G Q S F 82"),("ABHD14A","V96 L L H G K A F N 105"),("ABHD14B","F34 S V L L L H G I R F 43")]),
        ("nucleophile elbow",[("C. elegans","M140 I V C A S M A A Q Y 150"),("ABHD14A","A166 V L V S P S L S G H Y 176"),("ABHD14B","P106 V V I S P S L S G M Y 116")]),
        ("acid loop",[("C. elegans","V187 V W G E R D T S 194"),("ABHD14A","L218 I L Y G E L D H I 226"),("ABHD14B","L155 I V Y G D Q D P M 163")]),
        ("GHxCYL base motif",[("C. elegans","P216 D A G H A C Y L H 225"),("ABHD14A","R245 N A G H A C Y L H K 254"),("ABHD14B","K184 G A G H P C Y L D K 193")])]
yy=0.92
for title,items in blocks:
    axC.text(0.01,yy,title,fontsize=9,weight="bold"); yy-=0.075
    for nm,txt in items:
        axC.text(0.03,yy,f"{nm:12s}",fontsize=8.5,family="monospace")
        axC.text(0.16,yy,txt,fontsize=8.5,family="monospace"); yy-=0.055
    yy-=0.02
axC.set_title("C. Catalytic motifs: triad Ser145 / Asp193 / His220 and the HG motif are present in C. elegans; the elbow flanks (SPSLSG -> CASMAA) are not",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# ---- panel D: paralog-diagnostic tally ----
axD=fig.add_subplot(G[2,0])
axD.bar(["matches\nABHD14A","matches\nABHD14B","matches\nneither"],[18,19,75],color=["#c0504d","#4f9153","#b0b0b0"])
for i,v in enumerate([18,19,75]): axD.text(i,v+1.5,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
axD.set_ylabel("diagnostic alignment columns")
axD.set_title("D. At the 112 columns where the two human paralogs differ,\nC. elegans ABHD-14 sides with neither (18 vs 19, binomial p = 1.0)",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

# ---- panel E: nematode ortholog conservation ----
axE=fig.add_subplot(G[2,1])
cons=[("Ser145 nucleophile",96.9),("His220 base",95.4),("Asp193 acid",93.8),("His77 (HG)",92.3),
      ("Gly78 (HG)",87.7),("Gln79 oxyanion bbN",83.1),("Met146 oxyanion bbN",78.5),("Tyr223 (GHxCYL)",75.4),
      ("Ala147 elbow +2",56.9),("Pro169 (VAP)",50.8),("Phe81 pocket",49.2),("Cys143 elbow -2",13.8)]
labels=[c[0] for c in cons][::-1]; vals=[c[1] for c in cons][::-1]
cols=["#2f6fb5" if v>=70 else "#e08214" if v>=45 else "#c0504d" for v in vals]
axE.barh(labels,vals,color=cols)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): axE.text(v+1,i,f"{v:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
axE.set_xlim(0,112); axE.set_xlabel("% of 65 nematode orthologs with the C. elegans residue")
axE.tick_params(labelsize=7.5)
axE.set_title("E. Catalytic machinery is conserved across Nematoda;\nthe elbow flanks and pocket walls are not",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
